title: Life360 expands pet tracking with new $8 scannable tags and zoomie alerts | TechCrunch
summary: In many cases, pet owners just want to put their contact information on a pet’s tag, which is what the new scannable pet tags support. With the new features, the company is also making its pet trackers more affordable.
